purpose: Independently resolve every frame-1 PRESS revise decision using source-supported query-surface corrections or an explicit unsupported-family archive.

revision_decisions.replace_terms: Return the complete final OR-term list as revised_domain_terms_json. Preserve every unaffected source-supported term. Remove, decode, repair, or qualify only the defect identified in press_notes. Any added qualifier must be supported by term_evidence_json.
revision_decisions.archive_unsupported: Use only when the supplied direct English evidence cannot authorize a construct-specific retrieval phrase. revised_domain_terms_json must be an empty JSON list and the rationale must identify the evidence insufficiency.

normalization_rules: Remove internal publication-time marker tokens such as a standalone t0; the T0 boundary remains metadata, not query text.
Decode HTML artifacts such as standalone amp, lt, and gt into source-aligned words or safely expressed comparison phrases.
Repair PDF extraction splits and damaged mathematical names using the named metric in direct evidence.
Add disease, method, framework, actor, paper-object, or validation-role qualifiers when the prior phrase was overbroad, but do not invent a new construct.
Keep unaffected synonyms and historical surface forms so recall is not silently narrowed.
Do not insert Boolean operators into a term string; express each supported qualified alternative as a complete phrase in the JSON list.
Deduplicate case-insensitively and do not use target counts, model outcomes, downstream dimensions, or feature performance.
protected_fields: Every input field except revision_decision, revised_domain_terms_json, revision_rationale, and independent-review provenance must remain byte-identical and in the same row order.
